## Prompt A (2x2 key views)

Create a high-resolution 2x2 grid (1376x768) of authentic 16-bit GBA/DS pixel-art monster sprites on a pure solid white background (#FFFFFF). Turn the creature from the two attached reference images into crisp, detailed pixel-art sprites, keeping its exact design, proportions and colours. Do not add any part that is not in the references.

CRITICAL ANATOMICAL & DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS (MUST FOLLOW 100%):
1. Body: a huge, heavy, squat four-legged plant reptile, low to the ground and much wider than tall. A broad flat head with a very wide mouth at the front, a stocky barrel body, and exactly FOUR short thick stumpy legs, each ending in exactly three small white claws. No tail, no arms, no wings.
2. Colour palette (use only these families):
   - Skin (head, body, legs): teal green (#20B49C) with light aqua highlights (#5AD5C5), dark teal shadow (#107B6A) and deepest teal (#105241). A few small round darker spots on the skin.
   - Inside of the open mouth: salmon pink (#FF7B73) with a small white tooth or two (#FDFDFD).
   - Eye: one small fierce red-pink eye on each side of the head, partly hidden under the edge of the flower.
   - Foliage: thick shaggy fern-like leaf fronds hanging down over the shoulders, the sides and the back of the body like a mane, in leaf green (#5A9C39) and light green (#83DE7B).
   - Flower (most important part): ONE gigantic flower canopy on the back, wider than the whole body, made of exactly SIX rounded overlapping petals that form a dome and droop down over the sides with ragged lower edges. Coral red (#FF7B73) on top, crimson red (#DE4141) underside, pale pink speckles (#FFBDBD), petal seams in dark brown (#833100).
   - Crown: on top of the flower dome, ONE spiky crown-like cluster of pointed yellow spikes (#FFEE52 with mustard shading #DEBD29 and #BD6A31), sticking straight up.
   - Outlines: crisp 1-2px near-black outline (#101010), no anti-aliasing halo.
3. Counting rules: exactly four legs, exactly one flower with six petals, exactly one yellow spiky crown on top, exactly one head, exactly one mouth. Never add extra legs, extra flowers, a tail, vines or arms. Do not increase any count.
4. The mouth is open wide in the front views, showing the pink inside, like the front reference.

GRID LAYOUT (4 key poses, large and crisp, same scale, all four feet on the same baseline):
- Top-Left: SOUTH (0°, front view) — facing straight toward the viewer, symmetric: the wide head and open pink mouth in the centre at the bottom-front, both eyes visible, the two front legs in front at the left and right, the flower dome spreading wide above and to both sides, the yellow crown centred on top.
- Top-Right: WEST (270°, left side profile) — facing LEFT in a sharp side profile: the head and open mouth at the left end, one eye, the long low body extending to the right, two legs visible on the near side (one front, one rear), the flower dome above the body, the crown on top.
- Bottom-Left: NORTH-EAST (135°, back-right 3/4 view) — seen from behind and to the right, like the back reference: the rear of the body with fern fronds over the hips, the flower dome on top, the crown, the head hidden or barely visible beyond the flower to the upper right; rear legs in front, front legs further back.
- Bottom-Right: NORTH (180°, pure back view) — seen straight from behind, symmetric: the rear of the body, the two hind legs at the left and right, fern fronds draped over the back, the flower dome spreading wide above, the crown centred on top. No face visible.
